event_title: Teen Prahar — A Unique Musical Experience
event_description:
About the Event


TEEN PRAHAR – A unique musical experience


Time-Theory of Raagas: Evening & Night Raagas


- Pravin Godkhindi (Flute)

- Rahul Shivkumar Sharma (Santoor)

- Sanjeev Abhyankar (Hindustani Vocal)


From the Bhakti-fuelled moods of the morning to the contemplative melodies of dusk, Teen Prahar is a day-long festival celebrating the Time Theory of Raagas, a characteristic feature of Indian Classical Music.


After an 18-year journey celebrating India's rich musical traditions, Teen Prahar arrives in Chennai for the very first time.


Conceived by Banyan Tree Events in 2006, Teen Prahar began as a thematic festival showcasing ragas associated with three different time zones of the day in a single concert. Built on the tradition of dividing the day into prahars, each with its own ragas suited to its mood and hour, the festival has evolved into a larger celebration of Indian Classical Music, bringing together great maestros, young prodigies, and upcoming star performers on one stage.


Over the years, Teen Prahar has also showcased rare instruments such as the Sarangi, Sur Bahar, Clarinet, and Cello alongside traditional art forms such as Haveli Sangeet and Dhrupad. The festival has brought together artists and art forms in beautiful, never-before-seen combinations and ensembles.


We invite audiences in Chennai to join us for this special presentation of Teen Prahar and experience the richness and diversity of India's musical traditions.
